newsitem.title: HONG KONG: FORECAST - HK lowers '96 CPI estimate to 6.8 pct.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - HK lowers '96 CPI estimate to 6.8 pct.

text.p: Hong Kong consumer price inflation (CPI) has been revised downward to 6.8 percent for 1996, Financial Secretary Donald Tsang said on Tuesday.
"The forecast of consumer price inflation for 1996 is revised downwards to 6.8 percent, almost one percent less than what we have forecast earlier," Tsang said during a dinner speech.
Tsang, in his budget speech in March, said he expected the territory's CPI to be at 7.5 percent in 1996, down from 8.7 percent in 1995.
